output.answer: As of today (November 11, 2026), OpenAI has no single company-wide Chief Technology Officer. The last company-wide CTO, Mira Murati, left in September 2024 to found her own AI startup, and her role was not replaced. The CTO title is now split across divisions: Vijaye Raji has been CTO of Applications since September 2025 (joining via the Statsig acquisition, heading product engineering for ChatGPT and Codex), and Uday Ruddarraju — promoted to CTO of compute in July 2026 — now leads OpenAI's overall compute/infrastructure organization, taking over from Sachin Katti after his October 2026 departure.
caveats: OpenAI does not currently have a single company-wide CTO; anyone asking for 'OpenAI's CTO' should be directed to the division-level CTOs (Vijaye Raji for Applications, Uday Ruddarraju for compute), as OpenAI's own announcement confirms Murati's company-wide CTO role was not replaced.

Executive turnover at OpenAI has been high through 2025-2026 (Fidji Simo, Brad Lightcap, Denise Dresser and Sachin Katti all departed in 2026), so division-level leadership could change again with little notice.

passages.quote: Chief Technology Officer Mira Murati, VP Research Barret Zoph and Chief Research Officer Bob McGrew all announced their departures via X on Wednesday afternoon.

The changes come in the wake of several executive departures from OpenAI, including that of former Chief Technology Officer Mira Murati, who left and created a new AI startup; her role will not be replaced.
Vijaye Raji will step into a new role as CTO of Applications, reporting to Fidji Simo, following the acquisition of Statsig.
Uday Ruddarraju, who has been serving as OpenAI's CTO of compute, will replace Katti and lead the company's overall compute organization, according to a spokesperson.
OpenAI has promoted Indian-origin technology executive Uday Ruddarraju as chief technology officer for compute, a year after he joined the ChatGPT maker from Elon Musk's xAI.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's Chief Technology Officer Mira Murati announced her departure in September 2024; after she left to create a new AI startup, her role was not replaced.
Vijaye Raji became CTO of Applications in September 2025 following OpenAI's acquisition of Statsig, reporting to Fidji Simo and heading product engineering for ChatGPT and Codex.
OpenAI promoted Uday Ruddarraju to chief technology officer for compute in July 2026, a year after he joined the company from xAI.
Infrastructure lead Sachin Katti departed his role (last day November 15, 2026, remaining as advisor), and Uday Ruddarraju took over OpenAI's overall compute organization as its CTO.
